items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And he got Pops Foster, Paul Barbarin and Simeon. ... That's not mine. That's Paul Barbarin's.

ctx.x: Who replaced George Howe? Did Barbarin come in to replace Howe?

Well, no, he didn't replace George Howe at the time, because... I mean, he was just using local drummers from around. And then he got the idea of sending to Chicago, trying to get these men he had with'..these men that worked with King Oliver. See, that's when Barbarin... The first one was Pops Foster.
